First: BTC's June 28 UTC daily candle confirmed CLOSED at $59,578.35 (−$445.98, −0.74% from June 27's $60,024.33 close) — Day 6 of the exit gate is now LOCKED. Re-entry gate ($62,000) is now $2,421.65 (+4.07%) above confirmed close; do not re-enter before two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000 AND IBIT inflows resuming. Second: Samsung Blue House ceremony CONFIRMED June 29 KST — President Lee Jae-myung hosted Samsung Chairman Jay Y. Lee + SK Group Chairman Tae-won Choi at '3 Mega-Projects National Report Meeting'; Samsung committed 1,000T won ($648B): AI semiconductor fabs, AI data centers, batteries, displays; new Honam southwest cluster; largest corporate investment in Korean history. The Samsung confirmation is the only structural positive in tonight's dossier — it materially raises NVDA stop-reset probability from ~40% to ~60–65% and sets up SK Hynix for the strongest KOSPI open of the 2026 cycle. US equity levels unchanged from Friday: SPX 7,354.02 (−0.05%), Nasdaq 25,297.62 (−0.24%), VIX 18.41, UST10Y 4.38%, DXY 101.27. All three US-equity regime gates remain simultaneously breached (seventh consecutive session). Monday June 29 resolves four binaries in a single session: (1) NVDA stop Day 2 — close above $195 = reset, close below $195 = FULL EXIT mandatory; (2) SK Hynix KST open — first live price discovery for the confirmed Blue House catalyst; (3) SPCX bond distribution Day 5 — critical volume read; (4) Quarter-end rebalancing begins (JPMorgan estimates ~$165B in stock sales settling June 30). Conviction upgrade to HIGH: BTC Day 6 LOCKED is a definitive exit-gate trigger; do not re-enter crypto or add tech longs until June 29 closes resolve.

bear_case: Sunday's confirmed data leaves no ambiguity: BTC's exit gate is locked at Day 6, the US equity regime has been simultaneously in breach for seven sessions, and the macro headwinds (PCE 4.1%, IBIT outflows seventh consecutive day at $444.5M, Fear & Greed at 18) are structural rather than episodic. The Deribit June 26-27 quarterly settlement at ~$60K vs. max pain $72K — with 80% of $10.63B expiring worthless — is the clearest evidence that the crypto options market is fully repricing to a new structural range below $63,500, not a temporary dislocation. BTC Q2 2026 closed at −12%, the second consecutive losing quarter — a statistical rarity that historically signals extended distribution, not near-term reversal. The Samsung Blue House confirmation is the lone bull case, but it is a 10-year Korean national plan announced on a Sunday when US markets cannot respond in real time. The NVDA stop Day 1 clock — which started on Friday's June 26 close at $192.53 — means Monday's close either resets the framework or triggers a forced institutional exit of one of the year's most-crowded AI longs, adding supply overhang into the NFP week. Quarter-end rebalancing (~$165B JPMorgan estimates settling June 30) creates two sessions of concentrated mega-cap selling immediately after the weekend. The escalation signal is clear: SPX below 7,300 on any June 29 close converts the regime from STEP ASIDE to BEARISH, requiring reassessment of all long positions. The NFP July 2 binary into the July 3-6 holiday gap is the final risk amplifier — a strong print cements BofA's three-hike framework with no ability to rebalance over the long weekend. Invalidation: SPX closes above 7,460 AND VIX closes below 17 simultaneously; BTC posts two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000 with IBIT inflows resuming; NFP prints Goldilocks. All three simultaneously would convert STEP ASIDE to HOLD across all watchlist names.
